findings.expected: Per spec digest, Brain Scout tab shows input + disabled 'Scout it' button + 'expansion lands soon' note, and Favorites tab shows 'No favorites yet' — filter chips are described only as part of the Generator surface
findings.found: The full FilterBar (All/Real Estate/Law/Finance/Science + Any/Easy/Medium/Hard chips) renders at the top of ALL three tabs, above the 'Brain Scout' and 'Favorites' headings, because App.tsx line 51 renders <FilterBar> outside the view conditional ({view === 'generator' && <SurpriseHero/>} is conditional but FilterBar is not). The chips are interactive on those tabs but have no function there since generation lives on the Generator tab.
findings.evidence: Screenshots /Users/truman/Projects/prompt-spark/.swarm/runs/cycle-006-look-qa-mobile-scout.png and cycle-006-look-qa-mobile-favorites.png show Law/Hard chips active above the Brain Scout input and the Favorites empty state; rendered app-main textContent on Favorites tab captured as 'AllReal EstateLawFinanceScienceAnyEasyMediumHardFavoritesNo favorites yet'. May be intentional shared-filter state, but it contradicts the spec's tab-content descriptions, so flagging for the conductor to adjudicate.
